args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback succeeded — all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was needed — this was a rollback to a previously healthy production release.
